market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $2,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: ETH spot ~$2,327 on May 7 and falling (down ~$80 today, failed at $2,400). To dip to $2,000 in May, needs ~14% drawdown over 24 days. ETH has been weaker than BTC recently with bears in control per analyst. Plausible but a 14% drop is meaningful with low base rate in a single month absent a macro shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: ETH could continue bleeding to test $2,200/2,000 if macro reverses; or peace rally lifts crypto.
